YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1 Arusha – Ngorongoro Crater

Safari starts/ends in Arusha. Our driver will pick you from your overnight accommodation in Arusha town in the morning at 5:15 am and make your way to Ngorongoro for a full day exploring the crater floor. The area is world-renowned in its reputation and very small in its scale, so you will see other safari-goers. Don’t let that distract you from the beauty of the place or from the fact that this remains one of the only places on earth where you may see all of the Big Five at once: Lion, Leopard, Bull Elephant, African Buffalo, and Black Rhino. To maximize your time on the crater floor you will enjoy a special packed lunch at a scenic picnic spot by the hippo pool. Your journey will take you through this tremendous landscape that is constantly changing as animals move to and fro in search of pasture, water, or easy prey. In the evening drive back to the crater rim for dinner and overnight.

02DAY 2Ngorongoro Crater to Serengeti National Park

After an early breakfast in the morning, you will make your way to Serengeti national park for your full-day game drives in the endless pain of Serengeti national park. You will have a great time visiting retima hippo and the crocodile pool. You’ll continue your wildlife viewing for the rest of the day, stopping to enjoy a picnic lunch at your leisure. Full days ‘discover Serengeti’ game drives. The day for the big cats – cheetahs, leopards, and lions. In the evening drive to the camp for dinner and overnight.

03DAY 3Serengeti – Arusha

In the morning after breakfast, you will drive out for short SUNRISE to mid-morning game drives in the endless plain of Serengeti before you start your drives back to Arusha with game drives en-route. Accommodations in Arusha are not included, it is at your own arrangements. This is the end of the trip.
